ValidationRule.description: if Employment status = self employed then Approve Salary is Mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c, "Accept"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Employment_Status__c, "Self Employed"), ISBLANK(cc_Approved_Salary__c), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Application") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Approve Salary field, if Employment status is Self Employed.
